status_rule: After completing a task, set its check field to true. In future runs, only tasks with check false are eligible for work.
scope: Apply the pending 1L3T algorithm edits, then improve card/detail click behavior, filter controls, view modes, dataset view-state memory, mobile detail layout, and algorithm editor ordering without converting the app to a mobile native app or PWA.
assumptions: The app remains a static GitHub Pages app under C:\dev\alg-note\app.
PWA/mobile app installation work is out of scope for this checklist.
Existing personal states in localStorage should be migrated or tolerated when field names change.
The list view should omit puzzle images and prioritize fast scanning of case name, badges, setup, and algorithm text.
GitHub push is requested for completed implementation batches unless the user says otherwise.

tasks.title: Commit and push current 1L3T algorithm edits
allowed_fields: app/js/data.js bundled mirror of the same data
git staging, commit, push for these changes
protected_fields: scrambles arrays except representative scramble already edited
tasks.summary: Commit the already-applied 16-case 1L3T algorithm edit batch and push it to origin/main.
verify: Run python .\scripts\validate_alg_json.py .\alg\fto\1l3t.
Confirm git diff before commit contains only the expected data changes plus this checklist if intentionally included.
Confirm git status shows local main synced with origin/main after push.

tasks.title: Disable selection toggle inside detail view background
tasks.summary: Prevent clicks on the detail card/background from toggling the yellow selected state while keeping intentional controls active.
verify: Click a normal list card and confirm selection still toggles.
Open detail view and click empty/card background; confirm selected state does not change.
Confirm favorite, status, edit, save, cancel, previous, and next controls still work in detail view.

tasks.title: Convert favorite and status filters to on/off toggles
tasks.summary: Replace the current status select with independent on/off toggles for favorites, learning, and learned filters.
verify: Confirm each toggle can be turned on and off.
Confirm combinations filter predictably, including favorites plus learning.
Confirm filter reset clears the new toggles.
Confirm summary counts remain accurate.

tasks.title: Move output button to a prominent top action
allowed_fields: export button color and responsive styling
tasks.summary: Place the output/export button near the top with a distinct color so it is not visually mixed with filters.
verify: Confirm the export panel still opens.
Confirm full JSON and edits-only modes still switch.
Confirm mobile layout does not overflow horizontally.

tasks.title: Replace view toggle with three-mode switcher
allowed_fields: render branching for compact, list, and detail modes
tasks.summary: Change the current detail-view toggle into a segmented control with 간단히 보기, 목록형 보기, and 자세히 보기.
verify: Confirm exactly one view mode is active at a time.
Confirm mode changes preserve current filters and selection where appropriate.
Confirm labels fit on mobile without overlapping.

tasks.title: Add image-free list view cards
tasks.targets: C:\dev\alg-note\app\js\render.js; C:\dev\alg-note\app\css\style.css; C:\dev\alg-note\app\index.html if template changes are needed
tasks.summary: Implement a new horizontally long, vertically compact list-card view showing case name, badges, setup, and algorithm text without images.
verify: Confirm list view renders no puzzle images.
Confirm each row shows case name, recognition/status badges, setup, and at least the first algorithm.
Confirm multiple algorithms are indicated clearly without making rows too tall.
Confirm mobile and desktop rows do not overlap or overflow incoherently.

tasks.title: Remember filters and position per algset
tasks.summary: Remember the current filter, search, view mode, selected/detail case, and scroll position separately for 1L3T and LBT when switching datasets.
verify: Set filters and scroll in 1L3T, switch to LBT, then return and confirm the previous 1L3T state is restored.
Repeat the same check from LBT back to 1L3T.
Confirm missing or filtered-out selected cases fall back without errors.
Confirm restoration occurs after render so scroll position is effective.

tasks.title: Improve mobile detail view layout
protected_fields: desktop detail behavior unless required for consistency
tasks.summary: On mobile, make detail view behave as a clean single detail panel instead of overlapping card-like columns.
verify: Inspect a mobile-width viewport and confirm no adjacent card overlaps the detail panel.
Confirm previous/next/edit/favorite/status controls are reachable and not floating over content awkwardly.
Confirm puzzle image fits within the viewport.
Confirm setup and algorithm text remain readable.

tasks.title: Allow algorithm order changes in edit mode
tasks.summary: In edit mode, allow multiple algorithm rows to be reordered while preserving textarea focus and mobile scrolling usability.
verify: Create or open a case with multiple algorithms.
Change row order and save; confirm exported/merged algorithms preserve the new order.
Confirm textarea clicks still place the cursor and do not start dragging.
Confirm cancel discards order changes.

tasks.title: Update site name and icon branding
tasks.targets: C:\dev\alg-note\app\index.html; C:\dev\alg-note\app\css\style.css; C:\dev\alg-note\app icons/favicon files as needed
tasks.summary: Rename the site to swooyi's ALG note and replace the default browser icon with a simple sA monogram icon.
verify: Confirm the browser tab title uses swooyi's ALG note.
Confirm the visible app header uses swooyi's ALG note.
Confirm favicon/icon links resolve without 404 in the app.
Confirm the sA monogram remains legible at favicon size.
